critic.fix_suggestion: Merge the fuselage into a single continuous hull by overlapping the primary cylinder geometries along the longitudinal axis. Adjust the 'Z-offset' of each subsequent cylinder segment to -0.5 units relative to its neighbor, ensuring a 10% overlap at every junction point to eliminate visible gaps and create a seamless aerodynamic shell.

discrepancies.observed: Four engines are floating in space away from the wings.
discrepancies.reference: Engines are physically attached to pylons under the wing structure.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move and attach engine geometries to wing pylon positions.

discrepancies.observed: The main wing is detached from the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The wing root is seamlessly integrated into the lower side of the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move wing geometry to intersect with fuselage side surface.

discrepancies.observed: The vertical stabilizer and horizontal stabilizers are disconnected from the rear fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The empennage components are joined at a common root on the tail cone.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Move and attach tail surfaces to the rear fuselage geometry.

discrepancies.observed: The main body appears as separate, non-intersecting cylinders with gaps.
discrepancies.reference: A continuous, smooth aerodynamic shell forming a single hull.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: Merge or overlap cylinder geometries to eliminate gaps.
